This section provides an overview of the EO data available from Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. The data offer is gradually extending. 


::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## SentiWiki - additional information
Browse [SentiWiki](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/sentiwiki) to discover more about the Copernicus Sentinel Missions.
:::

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## SentiBoard - real-time status
Occasionally, operational events may affect the availability of Sentinel satellite data.<br>Visit [SentiBoard](https://operations.dashboard.copernicus.eu/index.html){target="_blank"} for a real-time view of Sentinel satellite data availability and processing status.
:::
